__inputs.label: InfluxDB
__inputs.description: Select your InfluxDB 2.x data source when importing

targets.query:
from(bucket: "Kiln")
  |> range(start: -5y)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "KILN MONITOR")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.KilnName == "${kiln}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.SessionId == "${session}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Zone1 temperature" or r._field == "Zone2 temperature" or r._field == "Zone3 temperature")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

startTimes = from(bucket: "Kiln")
  |> range(start: -5y)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "KILN MONITOR" and r.KilnName == "${kiln}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Zone1 temperature")
  |> group(columns: ["SessionId"])
  |> first()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["SessionId", "_time"])
  |> rename(columns: {SessionId: "session_id", _time: "session_start"})

endTimes = from(bucket: "Kiln")
  |> range(start: -5y)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "KILN MONITOR" and r.KilnName == "${kiln}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "Zone1 temperature")
  |> group(columns: ["SessionId"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["SessionId", "_time"])
  |> rename(columns: {SessionId: "session_id", _time: "session_end"})

join(tables: {start: startTimes, end: endTimes}, on: ["session_id"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
      startMs = uint(v: r.session_start) / uint(v: 1000000)
      endMs = uint(v: r.session_end) / uint(v: 1000000)
      pad = (endMs - startMs) / uint(v: 20)
      return {r with start_ms: startMs - pad, end_ms: endMs + pad}
  })
  |> sort(columns: ["session_start"], desc: true)
